Chapter 886: Chapter 22: Twelfth Layer Admission (Please Subscribe)

The Divine Ability ‘World’ could only be maintained for six seconds after activation.

During these six seconds, Lin Yuan decided to attempt to assassinate the Insect Race’s most powerful eleventh rank.

Mainly because the enmity between the Human Civilization Alliance and the Insect Race was too great.

Back when Lin Yuan was not yet grown, he had experienced several assassination attempts.

Most of which were plotted by the Insect Race.

Under such circumstances, the assassination target was naturally prioritized to be the Insect Race.

“Galaxy Master!”

The strongest of the Insect Race’s eleventh rank let out a high-pitched scream, sending out invisible soul fluctuations in all directions.

However, all the soul fluctuations seemed to sink into a quagmire when they touched Lin Yuan.

In the eyes of the strongest eleventh rank of the Insect Race, Lin Yuan’s descending right hand grew increasingly large, and the terrifying pressure even gave her the illusion that she was facing a supreme being.

Buzzing sounds.

At that moment, right above the head of the strongest eleventh rank of the Insect Race, the Nightmare Realm suddenly emitted a hazy glow.

This obscure light was completely different from the light emitted by the strongest eleventh rank of the Insect Race when they exerted their power; it was filled with the illusion that all things were but dreams.

Even Lin Yuan’s mind was briefly immersed in the moment, but in the next second, he broke free with his strong mental will.

“Hmm?”

“Such a strong mental will?”

A slightly surprised voice came through, and Lin Yuan looked up only to see a phantom figure slowly walking out of the Nightmare Realm.

The figure, although extremely ethereal, gave Lin Yuan a sense of immense reality, akin to the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being.

“Is this the ultimate twelfth rank?”

Lin Yuan’s figure vanished, reappearing above the altar.

Although he had long known that the killing of the most powerful eleventh rank would trigger the contingency left behind in the Clan Suppression Weapon by the ultimate twelfth rank, Lin Yuan had not expected it to be an ultimate phantom straightaway.

Even if this phantom was just one avatar of an ultimate existence, it was not something Lin Yuan could handle at the moment.

What’s more, the Clan Suppression Weapon was still in the hands of that ultimate member of the Insect Race; the damage caused by the ultimate avatar wielding the Clan Suppression Weapon, even if it did not reach one million points, was probably extremely close.

“Hahaha, Myriad Transformation Queen, as the ultimate being, showing up to bully a little guy seems a bit unreasonable, doesn’t it?” Inside the altar, a ring on Xuanyuan You’s right hand also shone brightly.

Likewise, it condensed a figure of a man, who from afar, looked towards the ultimate being emerging from the Nightmare Realm.

“It’s Xuanyuan Supreme.” Lin Yuan looked at the male figure, thinking quickly in his heart.

Among the Human Civilization Alliance’s nine supreme beings, Lin Yuan had the most contact with Xia Qin Supreme, as he was part of Xia You Evolution Tower.

As for Xuanyuan Supreme… Lin Yuan had not interacted much but knew that Xuanyuan Supreme was the very first supreme being to emerge from human civilization.

He was also the one among the nine supreme beings of human civilization who shouldered the most pressure and paid the highest price.

It’s known that human civilization obtained that ultimate opportunity with countless inheritances of treasure falling from outside the universe.

When human civilization had not yet risen, the ultimate twelfth rank beings of the Cosmic Starry Skies naturally would not take any interest in human civilization.

But when the first supreme being was born within human civilization, those ultimate twelfth rank beings naturally turned their attention to human civilization, leading to the exposure of the ultimate opportunity.

Human civilization and the then newly ascended twelfth rank Xuanyuan Supreme became the focus of the Cosmic Starry Skies.

One after another, the ultimate twelfth rank beings were poised to act, ready at any moment to besiege human civilization and seize the ultimate opportunity.

Xuanyuan Supreme paid an untold price to lead human civilization through that time until the second, third, and fourth supreme beings were born, which is when the situation of human civilization began to turn for the better.

…

“Myriad Transformation Queen.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze settled on the figure that had emerged from the Nightmare Realm.

Amongst all the queens of the Insect Race, the Myriad Transformation Queen was also one of the oldest and most powerful, and even the Clan Suppression Weapon, the Nightmare Realm, was personally forged by her.

“Queen.”

The strongest eleventh rank of the Insect Race bowed to the Myriad Transformation Queen; under normal circumstances, the contingency within the Nightmare Realm would only trigger when she truly faced a life-or-death situation.

The appearance of the Myriad Transformation Queen now meant that she indeed might have died at the hands of the Galaxy Master.

“The Galaxy Master really could kill me despite the Clan Suppression Weapon?” The strongest eleventh rank of the Insect Race found it hard to believe, but the Myriad Transformation Queen’s appearance could only mean one thing.

…

“Xuanyuan, haven’t you made a move as well?” The Myriad Transformation Queen smiled faintly; her invisible soul fluctuation aura influenced all life, causing all the eleventh rank powerhouses of the Human Civilization Alliance in the altar to involuntarily begin to immerse themselves.

“Hmph.”

Xuanyuan Supreme let out a cold snort, his voice resonating in the souls of all the eleventh rank powerhouses.

“Besides, you say there’s no problem with me bullying the Galaxy Master, but calling the Galaxy Master a little guy? Aren’t you underestimating him a bit too much?”

The Myriad Transformation Queen glanced meaningfully at the Galaxy Master and said, “The mental will of the Galaxy Master has probably already stepped into the twelfth rank, hasn’t it?”

“Is that still a little guy?”

Lin Yuan heard this and remained expressionless.

The reason he was quickly able to rid himself of the Myriad Transformation Queen’s soul influence just now was due to his strong mental will.

The Myriad Transformation Queen must have noticed something amiss.

“What? The psychic will of the Galaxy Master has reached the twelfth level?” The strongest Second Layer member of the Insect Race looked at Lin Yuan in shock.

Compared to the physical and soul enhancement, upgrading the psychic will is the most difficult, especially after reaching tens of millions of points where every increment demands a huge price.

But the Galaxy Master? Psychic will at the twelfth level?

The strongest Second Layer member of the Insect Race couldn’t comprehend, how long had the Galaxy Master been alive? How could his psychic will reach the twelfth level without the test of time?

“Psychic will at the twelfth level?” The other strongest Second Layer beings were also deeply shocked.

After the Myriad Transformation Queen of the Insect Race appeared, the duration of the Divine Ability ‘World’ was almost over, and at this moment, they could leave whenever they wanted.

But now that the Myriad Transformation Queen was present, these strongest Second Layer beings suddenly didn’t want to leave.

Originally, they only intended to observe the confrontation between the Myriad Transformation Queen of the Insect Race and the supreme beings of the Human Civilization Alliance, but they didn’t expect to hear such intelligence.

The Galaxy Master possesses a twelfth-level psychic will?

“No wonder I feel like I’m facing the ultimate when I’m against him?” The strongest Second Layer member of the Robber Clan silently thought.

Even for the Robber Clan, who have undergone countless trials, it was never possible to elevate the psychic will to the twelfth level during the Second Layer; it was too difficult.

“Hahaha, how is it a problem that our Human Civilization’s unparalleled prodigy has a twelfth-level psychic will?” Xuanyuan Supreme said unconcernedly, a psychic will at the twelfth level means that the contamination of supreme-level psychic memories is completely ineffective against Lin Yuan.

In other words, Lin Yuan has fully grown up, and the other ultimate twelfth-level beings can at most kill Lin Yuan’s avatar, unable to affect his true body.

“If I am not mistaken, there isn’t any ultimate foundation carried by the Galaxy Master, right?” The Myriad Transformation Queen continued, “The Yu Clan tried to weaken the life essence of the Galaxy Master with the balance scale, but it didn’t have any impact. The life essence of the Galaxy Master greatly exceeds the limit of the eleventh layer.”

The Myriad Transformation Queen paused for a moment, “If such a thick life essence truly activates the ultimate foundation, the power unleashed would be immense. Even the strongest of all races holding a Clan Suppression Weapon at the eleventh layer would not be able to withstand it.”

All the strongest Second Layer beings around were completely stunned.

The Galaxy Master didn’t activate the ultimate foundation? Ten years ago, the power of the Galaxy Master alone decimated tens of thousands of the eleventh level?

And just now, more than a dozen of the strongest Second Layer beings could only struggle to survive against the Galaxy Master by relying on the Clan Suppression Weapons because of the Galaxy Master’s own strength?

“Without any external force, the Galaxy Master could kill me even across the Clan Suppression Weapon?”

The strongest Second Layer member of the Insect Race was scared. She instinctively wanted to refute this claim, but it was the supreme Myriad Transformation Queen of the Insect Race who said it.

Even the bravest among the strongest Second Layer would not dare to question the words of the Myriad Transformation Queen.

…

Lin Yuan stood in the void above the altar, silently listening to the words of the Myriad Transformation Queen of the Insect Race.

“Although the ultimate twelfth-level can’t directly examine the world within my physical soul body, just by indirect observation and deduction, many of my secrets can still be revealed.”

This was also inevitable unless Lin Yuan never took action. Otherwise, for the ultimate beings of all major peak clans to discern some truths about him was almost a certainty.

Still the same saying.

Lin Yuan has now fully grown up. Even if some of his secrets are revealed, what can those peak clan forces’ supreme beings do to him?

“So our Human Civilization’s unparalleled prodigy has such qualifications, what of it?”

Xuanyuan Supreme remained unfazed, and in fact, he was secretly astonished.

He learned about the Yu Clan’s attempts to weaken Lin Yuan’s life essence with the balance scale after the fact.

Seeing that Lin Yuan’s strength was almost unaffected, he guessed that perhaps the Galaxy Master was really just relying on himself.

The words of Xuanyuan Supreme made the Myriad Transformation Queen fall silent.

The strongest Second Layer beings also had complicated thoughts.

Is this a matter of talent? What kind of freak is the Galaxy Master?

With the Galaxy Master around, their elfare at the eleventh layer seems like trash.

“Alright.”

“Myriad, there’s no need to say more.”

“What do you plan to do now? Will we advance to the final battle early, or continue to let the young ones fight among themselves?”

Xuanyuan Supreme directly spoke out.

Advancing to the final battle early meant that twelfth-level treasures or methods would officially come into play.

Of course, these treasures and methods do not refer to the battles among ultimate twelfth-level beings, but rather to the addition of more foundation treasures, escalating the war in all aspects.

The Eternal Spatial Rifts in those large-scale battlefields from before were caused by a blow from a supreme being with a power level reaching a million points, forming in the final battle.

However, the final battle usually happens towards the end of a massive war. As for now? Normally, the intensity of a large-scale war wouldn’t be high during the first ten to twenty years.

But due to the emergence of the Galaxy Master, the direction of the war development became a bit peculiar, prompting an alliance of various races ahead of time, and because the Galaxy Master had the ability to kill the strongest Second Layer of the Insect Race, it triggered the methods left by the Myriad Transformation Queen in the Nightmare Realm.

“Advance the final battle?”

The Myriad Transformation Queen smiled lightly, “There’s no need for that anymore, my Insect Race has decided to withdraw from this war.”

Continuing the fight, the Second Layer level would definitely be blocked by the supreme beings of the Human Civilization.

As for below the twelfth level? With the strength the Galaxy Master has now shown, not even the strongest eleventh levels holding the Clan Suppression Weapons or even the ultimate foundations are a match.

Once blood is truly shed, and the Human Civilization begins to let the Galaxy Master activate the ultimate foundation.

Wouldn’t the strongest eleventh levels of all the major peak clans be crushed underfoot by the Galaxy Master?
